texts.text: “Initially all of us three founders ran the recruiting process, and while it worked for a little while, it wasn’t something we were necessarily particularly good at or passionate about.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: We cared about hiring the best people, not about the first person who came knocking at our door. Also, we didn’t really have the tools or the time to reach outside our own networks, so we needed help to expand outside the inbound applicant pool.
texts.text: We cared about hiring the best people, not about the first person who came knocking at our door. Also, we didn’t really have the tools or the time to reach outside our own networks, so we needed help to expand outside the inbound applicant pool.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: At first we experimented with a couple of external boutique recruiting agencies, but it didn’t feel natural. This was mainly due to a consulting recruitment model where incentives are often tied to closed hires, so the recruiters are incentivized to make the hires as fast as possible. This is good for growing the team fast but hard when you want to hire only the best talent. The best and most sought-after people are often hard and slow to hire, and the process looks more like leadership recruiting.
